results.title: Indagine urbinate: "Così l'algoritmo influenza il voto"
results.snippet: Coverage of a study led by sociologist Fabio Giglietto at the University of Urbino, analyzing over 2.5 million social media posts from Meta between 2021 and 2025. The article details Giglietto's findings on how Meta's recommendation algorithms reduced the visibility of Italian parliamentarians while inadvertently boosting extremist content.

results.title: Algoritmi e democrazia: il caso Meta secondo lo studio Uniurb che ha avviato un'interrogazione al Parlamento europeo
results.snippet: Press feature and official news release highlighting Fabio Giglietto's research ('A Pretty Blunt Approach') on Meta's political content reduction policies. The study was cited by Rai3's 'Report' program and sparked a formal inquiry in the European Parliament.
